verdict.rationale: monday.com's own site says its agents surface actionable insights from your data, spot risks and progress gaps, generate scheduled performance reports, and score deals, which covers in-product AI insights and suggestions. The evidence is homepage marketing taglines only, with no detailed documentation or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how insights are generated and shown, independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on which data sources and views support AI suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Surface deep intelligence and actionable insights from any subject.
Spot risks and progress gaps before they become problems.
Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
Score our open deals and send proposals to anyone above 80%.
